explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

if your english level is below a-level level, you don't have to use the word XXXXX. so for example, if the english level of a person is a b, he doesn't have to use the word XXXXX.

but if your english level isn't a-level, you have to use the word XXXXX. in that case, you must tell him why you think so.
